summary: 26/31 PASS. All 5 failures stem from two root causes concentrated in the unicode10-0-0 and infrastructure modules. (1) unicode10-0-0: the agent grouped 21 nearly-identical Unicode data files under a single shared set of 4 sections instead of documenting each file individually — violating the Skill's explicit 'EVERY file MUST have ALL 4 sections. No exceptions.' rule. Appendix G confirms 6/26 complete section sets (77% deficit). This is primarily an agent execution error, compounded by the Skill lacking an explicit anti-pattern example. (2) infrastructure: only 19/45 files documented (42% per-module coverage) because the 50000-token budget cap was exhausted against a 180988-token module — this is a Skill design limitation. The highest-impact fixes are: (a) add a grouped-block anti-pattern prohibition with example to phase3-detail.md, and (b) increase the token budget cap for modules exceeding 100k tokens.
